notes.title: Upcoming update for MathTower2
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce an upcoming update for MathTower2 that will take your experience to the next level! Now, you can enjoy the fantastic voice feature for numbers and mathematical operations available in both English and Spanish. This incredible enhancement is not only a fun addition but also a powerful tool for language learning and pronunciation improvement.

[previewyoutube=LKxGXnfZa8Q;full][/previewyoutube]

But that's not all! We've also upgraded the graphics, giving MathTower2 a fresh and captivating look. To make your gameplay even more enjoyable, we've added some exciting new modes that allow you to have a blast while practicing addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and learning numbers in both English and Spanish.

Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity to boost your math skills and language proficiency in a fun and engaging way! Be sure to visit our website at https://www.ticosgames.com/ for more information and stay tuned for the release date of the update.

Join us in the MathTower2 adventure, where learning meets entertainment! See you soon!
